f.title: Code J2.4.k by EPPV status, two-year status, generic or biosimilar status
f.statement: Cases obtained during the EPPV period are reported as "during EPPV" regardless of application category (for partial-change approvals, when the use falls, or may fall, under the changed matters subject to EPPV; otherwise by the status of the new-active-ingredient approval). Drugs within two years of approval that do not fall under Art 228-20(1)(i-2) and cases not from EPPV are coded "not applicable"; generics are "not applicable" even within two years; biosimilars follow the status based on their first approval as a biosimilar.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (製造販売業者)
rows.quote:
○ 承認申請の区分に関わらず、市販直後調査期間中に得られた症例は、市販
直後調査中として報告すること。なお、承認事項一部変更申請に基づき承
認された医薬品において、変更事項が市販直後調査の対象とされた場合に
は、当該医薬品の使用が市販直後調査の対象とされた変更事項に該当する
場合又は該当するか否かが不明の場合、市販直後調査中として報告するこ
と。当該医薬品の使用が市販直後調査の対象とされた変更事項に該当しな
い場合は、新有効成分含有医薬品としての承認に基づく状況区分に従って
報告すること。
○ 承認後２年以内の医薬品であっても、規則第 228 条の 20 第１項第１号の二
に該当せず、かつ、市販直後調査により得られた症例以外の場合は「該当
なし」として報告すること。
○ 後発医薬品の場合、承認から２年以内であっても「該当なし」を記載する
こと。
○ バイオ後続品の場合、バイオ後続品として初めての承認に基づく状況区分
に従って記載すること。

○ Irrespective of the category of the approval application, report cases obtained during the early post-marketing phase vigilance period as "under early post-marketing phase vigilance". For a drug approved on the basis of a partial change application, where the change is made subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance, report as "under early post-marketing phase vigilance" where the use of the drug falls under the change made subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance or where it is unclear whether it does. Where the use of the drug does not fall under that change, report in accordance with the status category based on approval as a drug containing a new active ingredient.
○ Even for a drug within 2 years of approval, report "not applicable" where it does not fall under Article 228-20(1)(i-2) of the Regulations and the case was not obtained through early post-marketing phase vigilance.
○ For generic drugs, enter "not applicable" even within 2 years of approval.
○ For biosimilars, enter in accordance with the status category based on the first approval as a biosimilar.

For foreign cases, enter the sender's action, not the action of the foreign company. Complete this item from the first report.

f.title: Fill trial J2.11 in the prescribed order
f.statement: Trial J2.11 gives other reference matters in this order: cumulative counts where the ADR is the same as previously reported cases; where a completed report is re-submitted as completed with additions or changes in free-text items, a brief description of them; the related listings in the precautions, application summary or Investigator's Brochure; where the same foreign case must be reported both post-marketing and as a trial report, that it has been or will be submitted as a post-marketing foreign ADR or infection report; and for blinded double-blind trial reports, the comparator's generic name, dose etc. (for foreign cases, as far as known). (The last list item follows a page footer and is not quoted.)

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor (治験依頼者)
rows.quote:
その他参考となる事項を以下の順で記載すること。
 ○ これまでに報告された症例と同一の副作用等である場合、累積報告件数を
    記載する。
 ○ 自由記載の項目について、完了報告後に改めて完了報告として報告する場
    合であって、自由記載項目内に前報告からの追加・変更箇所がある場合
    は、自由記載項目内の追加・変更箇所について簡潔に記載すること。
 ○ 当該報告に関連する使用上の注意、承認申請の資料概要又は治験薬概要書
    上の記載事項
 ○ 同一の外国症例をそれぞれ市販後及び治験で報告する必要がある場合、    「外
    国副作用報告（市販後）  」又は「外国感染症報告（市販後）」において既に
    提出済である旨又は提出予定である旨
 ○ 二重盲検による試験からの報告について盲検解除前の場合、対照薬等の一
    般的名称、投与量等の情報。外国症例の場合は、知り得る範囲で対照薬等
    の一般的名称、投与量等の情報を記載することで差し支えない。

rows.quote_en:
Enter other matters for reference in the following order:
○ Where the adverse reaction etc. is the same as in cases reported so far, enter the cumulative number of reports.
○ For free-text items, where a case is reported again as a completion report after a completion report and there are additions or changes from the previous report in free-text items, briefly describe the additions or changes in the free-text items.
○ The relevant descriptions in the precautions for use, the summary of application materials or the investigator's brochure.
○ Where the same foreign case needs to be reported both post-marketing and in clinical trials, that it has already been submitted, or is to be submitted, as a "foreign adverse reaction report (post-marketing)" or "foreign infection report (post-marketing)".
○ For reports from double-blind trials before unblinding, information such as the non-proprietary name and dose of the comparator etc. For foreign cases, it is acceptable to enter such information to the extent known.

f.title: Enter the compound code in J2.12 and per-trial summaries in J2.13, using "$TT$" for the subject's trial
f.statement: J2.12 gives the compound code in the clinical trial notification (or the development code in the protocol if no notification). J2.13 gives, for every trial in progress of investigational products with the same active ingredient, the notification count (J2.13.r.1) and whether patients are on treatment (J2.13.r.4) — also target disease and phase when reporting on the notification day — and the latest trial even after completion; where no notification is required, leave J2.13.r.1 blank and give disease and phase from the protocol; mark the subject's trial with "$TT$" in J2.13.r.2.

rows.quote:
治験成分記号は、治験計画届書に記載している治験成分記号を記載すること。
治験計画届書を提出していない場合には、治験実施計画書に記載している開発コ
ードを記載すること。
（キ）国内治験概要（J2.13）
治験実施期間内にある有効成分が同一であるすべての治験薬の治験について、
治験ごとに「届出回数（J2.13.r.1）」及び「投薬中の症例の有無（J2.13.r.4） 」
を記載すること。ただし、治験計画届出日当日に副作用報告を行う場合にあって
は、「対象疾患（J2.13.r.2）
」及び「開発相（J2.13.r.3）
」についても記載する
こと。治験が終了し、申請準備中又は申請中の場合や治験実施期間外であっても
直近の治験の概要を記載すること。なお、治験計画届の提出を必要としない場合
は、「届出回数（J2.13.r.1）
」は空欄とし、「対象疾患（J2.13.r.2）」及び「開発
相（J2.13.r.3）
」には治験実施計画書に記載されている内容を記載すること。ま
た、当該被験者が参加している試験情報については、 「対象疾患（J2.13.r.2）
」
に、半角英数で「$TT$」と入力すること。治験計画届を必要としない場合等「対
象疾患（J2.13.r.2）
」に対象疾患を記載する必要がある場合には、 「$TT$」に続
けて対象疾患を記載すること。

rows.quote_en:
Enter as the investigational ingredient code the code stated in the clinical trial notification. Where no clinical trial notification has been submitted, enter the development code stated in the protocol.
(g) Domestic clinical trial summary (J2.13)
For all clinical trials, within their conduct period, of investigational products with the same active ingredient, enter for each trial "Notification count (J2.13.r.1)" and "Whether there are cases under administration (J2.13.r.4)". However, where the adverse reaction report is made on the day of the clinical trial notification, also complete "Target disease (J2.13.r.2)" and "Development phase (J2.13.r.3)". Enter the summary of the most recent trial even where trials have ended and an application is in preparation or has been filed, or outside the trial conduct period. Where no clinical trial notification is required, leave "Notification count (J2.13.r.1)" blank and enter in "Target disease (J2.13.r.2)" and "Development phase (J2.13.r.3)" the content stated in the protocol. For the trial in which the subject is participating, enter "$TT$" in half-width alphanumerics in "Target disease (J2.13.r.2)". Where the target disease needs to be entered in "Target disease (J2.13.r.2)", such as where no clinical trial notification is required, enter the target disease after "$TT$".

Withdrawals set C.1.11.1 "1 = nullification", give the ground in C.1.11.2, set J2.7.1 "Completed" and leave J2.8.1/J2.8.2 blank.

As a rule, a withdrawal report is possible only where one of ① to ⑥ below applies. When making a withdrawal report, set "Report nullification/amendment (C.1.11.1)" to "1 = nullification", enter the applicable reason from ① to ⑥ below in "C.1.11.2 Reason for nullification/amendment", select "Completed" for "Completed/not completed category (J2.7.1)", and make the withdrawal report. Do not complete "Outside-scope flag (J2.8.1)" and "Reason for outside scope (J2.8.2)".
① For a domestic case, where it is found that the company's drug was not administered.
② For a foreign case, where it is found that neither the company's drug nor a foreign drug containing the same active ingredient was administered.
③ Where it is found that the event occurred before administration of the drug and the reporting physician and the reporting company have judged that there is no causal relationship (except where the drug aggravated the event).
④ Where it is found that the same information was reported in duplicate.
⑤ Where the following items were entered in error: "Identification number (report category) (J2.1a)", "Sender's (case) safety report unique identifier (C.1.1)", "Worldwide unique case identifier (C.1.8.1)", "First sender of this case (C.1.8.2)".

rows.quote_en:
The date of receipt and date of transmission for each reporting method are as follows. However, where PMDA instructs resubmission at receipt to correct deficiencies etc., the date on which PMDA receives the resubmitted report is the date of receipt of that report.
(1) Electronic reports
The report is regarded as made when it is registered in PMDA's electronic data processing system, and that date is shown in "Acknowledgement date of batch transmission (ACK.M.4)" in the acknowledgement message items. Reports up to 23:59 are received on that day. Note in advance that, for reports sent during the nightly system maintenance etc., the date and time at which the report is recorded after the maintenance ends is treated as the date of receipt. "Date of batch transmission (N.1.5)" is the date and time of electronic transmission.
(2) CD etc. reports
The report is regarded as made when it is registered in PMDA's electronic data processing system, and that date is shown in ACK.M.4. N.1.5 is the date of submission at the counter or the date of posting.
(3) Paper reports
The date of receipt is the date of submission where submitted at the PMDA counter, and the date of receipt by PMDA where sent by post etc. The identification number is issued not at receipt of the paper report but when the ICSR file is registered in PMDA's electronic data processing system. N.1.5 is the date of submission at the counter or the date of posting.
